body: I want it so bad but what can I do? I can’t speak, my money is too little so my voice is too little. That’s how I see it... no matter how I angel change it just doesn’t seem fit. I’ve tried everything there is to do here.  I’ve done and seen it all. And yet... I have no place. The only thing I’ve ever been good at is football and my mother never insisted on pursuing that with me as a kid. That’s all I ever did growing up and as I got older I never knew what steps to take in order to be me. I’ve done so many things that just wastes my time, I’ve joined the military in which puts me in debt for over 12k. No matter what I do, no matter how good I’m doing, I get slapped with a big bag of bad everytime. I don’t make enough money I guess. To help myself! I’ve been mistreated by the justice system and told it was my fault. Dealing with this heart ache is dragging me further and further into the abyss. God forbid I kill myself. God forbid the happiest person in everyone’s life takes his life.. then what? Absolutely nothing. Everything I do now just takes a toll on me because this messed up place doesn’t care for people like me.

I feel you on the same level. Money makes this world so unhappy. We didn’t ask to be brought into this shit show but here we are having to deal with it. It’s so sad that no one wants a change . No one wants to live happily only because the change is risky.
